merge-siege.goal: Smash every enemy before one reaches your bottom row.
merge-siege.how-to-play.step-1: Swipe to slide all your tiles at once.
merge-siege.how-to-play.step-2: Two equal tiles merge into one bigger tile.
merge-siege.how-to-play.step-3: A tile smashes any enemy with the same number or a smaller one.
merge-siege.how-to-play.step-4: Enemies march down as you swipe. Keep them off your bottom row.
merge-siege.name: Merge Siege
merge-siege.tagline: Merge your tiles. Smash the siege.
merge-siege.tutorial.step-1: Swipe up to send your tiles at the enemies.
merge-siege.tutorial.step-2: Equal tiles merge. Swipe sideways to join them.
merge-siege.tutorial.step-3: A bigger tile smashes a bigger enemy. Swipe up!
merge-siege.tutorial.step-4: Smash the last enemy before it reaches your bottom row.
